story.title: The Beast That Walks Romania's Dark Woods

sentences.text: If a howling beast follows you at night in Transylvania... don't look back.
sentences.image: misty pine forest at night with a full moon

sentences.text: The old tales say that certain troubled souls awaken from their graves as monsters.
sentences.image: ancient stone cross in an overgrown graveyard

sentences.text: They take the terrifying form of a giant wolf that stalks the quiet mountain paths.
sentences.image: shadow of a massive wolf on a dirt road

sentences.text: Villagers believe these creatures wander the freezing dark to terrorize the unwary.
sentences.image: dimly lit wooden cabin window looking into the woods

sentences.text: If you walk alone through the dense forests, you might hear heavy footsteps behind you.
sentences.image: lone traveler walking with a small lantern

sentences.text: The legends warn that the monster grows closer with every single step you take.
sentences.image: close up of pine needles on the ground in moonlight

sentences.text: Suddenly, hot breath brushes against your neck from the shadows right behind your shoulder.
sentences.image: dark silhouette looming directly behind a startled person
glowing yellow eyes peering from the dark woods
